brief.empty: Nothing to do. The backlog is empty and the project is clean.
brief.gates:
Gates that will judge this unit (all must pass before merge):
  cairn hook all                                       # exit 0
  cairn scan                                           # zero findings

Cairn resolves and runs the project's gates via accept; the brief shows the exact recipe:
brief.gates-skip: language battery ({language})                          # skipped (no gates configured for {language}; configure a `gates:` section in cairn.config.yaml to run build/test checks)
brief.none-ready: No ready work: every open bead is blocked by a dependency. Run `bd ready` and `bd blocked` to see what is gated.
brief.not-found: No bead matches `{id}`. Run `bd ready` to list available work.
brief.not-ready: Warning: this bead is not in the ready set (closed, or blocked by an open dependency). It may already be done or not yet actionable; check `bd ready` before working it.
brief.not-ready-todo: Warning: this todo is not open (in progress, done, or blocked). Check its status in meta/todos/ before working it.
brief.staleness-note-beads: Note: the beads export can lag live Dolt. `bd ready` is authoritative; cross-check before committing to this unit.
brief.staleness-note-todos: Note: native todos live in meta/todos/ and are authoritative for the current checkout; reconcile against the repository's own task tracking before committing to this unit.
brief.todo-not-found: No todo matches `{id}`. Run `cairn status` to list open todos.
brief.unlinked-hint: No graph node is linked to this bead, so no node-specific decisions or contract are surfaced. Bind one with `bd update {id} --label cairn-node:<node>` so future briefs load its constraints.

feedback.usage: usage: cairn feedback "<what you expected, what happened instead>" [--area <area>] [--severity <level>]

CAIRN_CHANGE_TASKS_COMPLETE.cta: Run `cairn change apply {node}` to archive it.
CAIRN_CHANGE_TASKS_COMPLETE.heading: Change tasks complete

CAIRN_CONFIG_UNKNOWN_KEY.body: cairn.config.yaml contains an unrecognised top-level key.
CAIRN_CONFIG_UNKNOWN_KEY.cta: Use a supported key (`context`, `rules`, `artefact_types`, `targets`, `multi_target`, `ignore`, `gates`) or remove the entry.
CAIRN_CONFIG_UNKNOWN_KEY.heading: Unknown config key

CAIRN_CONTRACT_MISSING.cta: Create a contract artefact describing this node's interface.
CAIRN_CONTRACT_MISSING.heading: Missing contract

CAIRN_CONTRACT_MISSING_NODE.body: A contract references `{node}`, which does not exist in the blueprint.
CAIRN_CONTRACT_MISSING_NODE.cta: Fix the node reference in the contract, or declare the missing node.
CAIRN_CONTRACT_MISSING_NODE.heading: Contract references unknown node

CAIRN_DECISION_ORPHANED.body: Decision `{node}` references nodes that no longer exist.
CAIRN_DECISION_ORPHANED.cta: Update the decision's node references, or archive if no longer relevant.
CAIRN_DECISION_ORPHANED.heading: Orphaned decision

CAIRN_INTEGRITY_DUPLICATE_ID.body: The ID `{node}` appears more than once in the blueprint.
CAIRN_INTEGRITY_DUPLICATE_ID.cta: Rename one of the duplicates to make every ID unique.
CAIRN_INTEGRITY_DUPLICATE_ID.heading: Duplicate node ID

CAIRN_INTEGRITY_INVALID_EDGE_ENDPOINT.body: An edge references `{target}`, which does not exist in the map.
CAIRN_INTEGRITY_INVALID_EDGE_ENDPOINT.cta: Check the edge declaration for typos, or declare the missing node.
CAIRN_INTEGRITY_INVALID_EDGE_ENDPOINT.heading: Invalid edge endpoint

CAIRN_INTEGRITY_PATH_TIE.cta: Narrow one node's path pattern so each file has exactly one owner.
CAIRN_INTEGRITY_PATH_TIE.heading: Path ownership conflict

CAIRN_INTERFACE_HASH_CHANGED.body: The contract hash for `{node}` no longer matches the last recorded value.
CAIRN_INTERFACE_HASH_CHANGED.cta: Run `cairn scan` to accept the new hash, or revert the contract change.
CAIRN_INTERFACE_HASH_CHANGED.heading: Interface changed

CAIRN_MODULE_OVERSIZED.body: `{path}` in `{node}` exceeds the 500-line module-size guideline with no allow-list marker.
CAIRN_MODULE_OVERSIZED.cta: Split the module, or add a `cairn:allow-large-module reason: ...` marker as its first non-blank line.
CAIRN_MODULE_OVERSIZED.heading: Module too large

CAIRN_ORDER_CYCLE.body: A cycle in ordering constraints (dependency edges, or containment contradicting a dependency edge) was detected involving `{node}`.
CAIRN_ORDER_CYCLE.cta: Break the cycle by removing or reversing one conflicting edge.
CAIRN_ORDER_CYCLE.heading: Ordering cycle

CAIRN_PROVENANCE_NO_DECISION.body: Node `{node}` has no decision in its provenance chain.
CAIRN_PROVENANCE_NO_DECISION.cta: Link a decision artefact explaining why this module exists.
CAIRN_PROVENANCE_NO_DECISION.heading: No decision link

CAIRN_RECONCILE_EMPTY_TARGET.body: The target `{target}` at `{path}` discovered zero files during reconciliation.
CAIRN_RECONCILE_EMPTY_TARGET.cta: Check the path is correct, or remove the target if it is no longer needed.
CAIRN_RECONCILE_EMPTY_TARGET.heading: Empty target

CAIRN_RECONCILE_LANGUAGE_UNKNOWN.body: The target `{target}` at `{path}` has a language that could not be inferred from its contents.
CAIRN_RECONCILE_LANGUAGE_UNKNOWN.cta: Set a `targets:` override in cairn.config.yaml, or add files with a supported extension.
CAIRN_RECONCILE_LANGUAGE_UNKNOWN.heading: Unknown language

CAIRN_RECONCILE_ORPHANED_FILE.body: The file `{path}` exists on disk but no blueprint node claims its path.
CAIRN_RECONCILE_ORPHANED_FILE.cta: Add a `path` entry to an existing node, or declare a new node.
CAIRN_RECONCILE_ORPHANED_FILE.heading: Orphaned file

CAIRN_SOURCE_UNVERIFIED.body: Source `{node}` has not been verified against its declared hash.
CAIRN_SOURCE_UNVERIFIED.cta: Run `cairn scan` to verify, or update the source record.
CAIRN_SOURCE_UNVERIFIED.heading: Unverified source

CT001.body: Targets for `{node}` with the same contract role have divergent interfaces.
CT001.cta: Review the contract and reconcile the interface shapes.
CT001.heading: Interface contradiction

CT002.body: An intentional asymmetry was detected in `{node}` for contract role `{target}`.
CT002.cta: Review the rationale to confirm the asymmetry is still correct.

types.extra-edge: A declared edge has no observed source dependency.
types.ghost-node: A declared node has no source files on disk.
types.interface-contradiction: Multiple contracts for the same role have divergent interfaces.
types.missing-edge: An observed dependency has no declared blueprint edge.

types.rationale-tension: An intentional asymmetry was detected; review the rationale.

init.already: Cairn is already initialized here (cairn.blueprint exists).
init.next-steps:
Next steps:
  1. Describe your system in cairn.blueprint (a starter was written)
  2. Run `cairn scan` to reconcile the blueprint against your code
  3. Wire cairn into your agent: `cairn init --wire` (appends a reference to
     CLAUDE.md or AGENTS.md automatically; skip if your agent ignores these)
  4. Point your agent at .claude/skills/cairn-dev to follow the dev loop

Existing codebase? `cairn init --from-code --apply` maps it in one step.
init.next-steps-existing:
Next steps:
  1. Run `cairn scan` to reconcile the blueprint against your code
  2. Run `cairn status` to review findings and backlog
  3. Wire cairn into your agent: `cairn init --wire`

Want to re-derive modules from code? `cairn init --from-code`.
